name: Ship of Harkinian
by: HarbourMasters, on the Ocarina of Time decompilation (zeldaret/oot)
about: Ocarina of Time rebuilt from its decompiled code: widescreen, high resolutions and frame rates, hundreds of enhancements, cheats and a randomizer. The first start builds oot.o2r from your own ROM (a few seconds) and asks once to start the game; after that it starts straight in. The in-game menu (F1 or Back on a controller) has its randomizer and trackers.

game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
game.why: It was made from one of the ROMs Ship of Harkinian lists (N64 1.0 to 1.2, GameCube, Master Quest); it checks the ROM itself when it builds oot.o2r.

settings.label: Menu Theme
settings.desc: Changes the Theme of the Menu Widgets.

settings.label: Menu Controller Navigation
settings.desc: Allows controller navigation of the port menu (Settings, Enhancements,...) CAUTION: This will disable game inputs while the menu is visible.  D-pad to move between items, A to select, B to move up in scope.

settings.label: Cursor Always Visible
settings.desc: Makes the cursor always visible, even in full screen.

settings.label: Search In Sidebar
settings.desc: Displays the Search menu as a sidebar entry in Settings instead of in the header.

settings.label: Search Input Autofocus
settings.desc: Search input box gets autofocus when visible. Does not affect using other widgets.

settings.label: Boot Sequence
settings.desc: Configure what happens when starting or resetting the game.  Default: LUS logo -> N64 logo Authentic: N64 logo only File Select: Skip to file select menu Debug Warp Screen: Skip to the debug warp screen Warp Point: Skip to active warp point (if set), see Dev Tools -> General

settings.label: Text to Speech
settings.desc: Enables text to speech for in-game dialogue

settings.label: Disable Idle Camera Re-Centering
settings.desc: Disables the automatic re-centering of the camera when idle.

settings.label: Disable Screen Flash for Finishing Blow
settings.desc: Disables the white screen flash on enemy kill.

settings.label: Disable Jabu Wobble
settings.desc: Disable the geometry wobble and camera distortion inside Jabu.

settings.label: Disable Heat Haze
settings.desc: Disable the heat haze distortion effect in Death Mountain / Fire Temple.

settings.label: ImGui Menu Scaling
settings.desc: Changes the scaling of the ImGui menu elements.

settings.label: Internal Resolution
settings.desc: Multiplies your output resolution by the value inputted, as a more intensive but effective form of anti-aliasing.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing (MSAA)
settings.desc: Activates MSAA (multi-sample anti-aliasing) from 2x up to 8x, to smooth the edges of rendered geometry. Higher sample count will result in smoother edges on models, but may reduce performance.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.desc: Extra frames made between the game’s own 20: smoother, the game runs the same. Above your display’s refresh rate it only costs power.

settings.label: Match Refresh Rate
settings.desc: Matches interpolation value to the refresh rate of your display.

settings.label: Enable Vsync
settings.desc: Removes tearing, but clamps your max FPS to your display's refresh rate.

settings.label: Windowed Fullscreen
settings.desc: Enables Windowed Fullscreen Mode.

settings.label: Allow multi-windows
settings.desc: Allows multiple windows to be opened at once. Requires a reload to take effect.

settings.label: Position
settings.desc: Which corner of the screen notifications appear in.

settings.label: Duration (seconds)
settings.desc: How long notifications are displayed for.

settings.label: Size
settings.desc: How large notifications are.

settings.label: Mute Notification Sound
settings.desc: Prevent notifications from playing a sound.

settings.label: Autosave
settings.desc: Save the game automatically on a 3 minute interval and when soft-resetting the game. The interval autosave will wait if the game is paused in any way (dialogue, pause screen up, cutscenes, etc.).  The soft-reset save will *not* trigger in cutscene maps like the Chamber of Sages!

settings.label: Notification on Autosave
settings.desc: Show a notification when the game is autosaved.

settings.label: Remember Save Location
settings.desc: When loading a save, places Link at the last entrance he went through. This doesn't work if the save was made in grottos, fairy fountains, or dungeons.

settings.label: Better Save Menu
settings.desc: Replaces the authentic save menu with a textbox that asks Yes or No for saving, then asks if you want to Continue, Reset, or Reset to Spawn.

settings.label: Containers Match Contents
settings.desc: Toggle to change container textures to match their contents in randomizer games. Categories: Major items, Lesser items, Junk items, Small keys, Boss keys, Skulltula Tokens.

settings.label: Containers of Agony
settings.desc: Only change the texture of containers if you have the Stone of Agony.

settings.label: Nighttime GS Always Spawn
settings.desc: Nighttime Skulltulas will spawn during both day and night.

settings.label: Pull Grave During the Day
settings.desc: Allows graves to be pulled when child during the day.

settings.label: Dampe Appears All Night
settings.desc: Makes Dampe appear anytime during the night, not just his usual working hours.

settings.label: Exit Market at Night
settings.desc: Allows exiting Hyrule Castle Market Town to Hyrule Field at night by speaking to the guard next to the gate.

settings.label: Shops and Games Always Open
settings.desc: Shops and Minigames are open both day and night. Requires a scene reload to take effect.

settings.label: Allow the Cursor to be on Any Slot
settings.desc: Allows the cursor on the pause menu to be over any slot. Sometimes required in Randomizer to select certain items.

settings.label: Pause Warp
settings.desc: Selection of warp song in pause menu initiates a warp. Disables song playback.

settings.label: Answer Navi Prompt with L Button
settings.desc: Speak to Navi with L but enter First-Person Camera with C-Up.

settings.label: Don't Require Input for Credits Sequence
settings.desc: Removes the Input Requirement on Text boxes after defeating Ganon, allowing the Credits Sequence to continue to progress.

settings.label: Include Held Inputs at the Start of Pause Buffer Input Window
settings.desc: Typically, inputs that are held prior to the buffer window are not included in the buffer. This setting changes that behavior to include them. This may cause some inputs to be re-triggered undesireably, for instance Z-Targeting something you might not want to.

settings.label: Pause Buffer Input Windowframes
settings.desc: Adds back in a delay after unpausing before the game resumes playing again, where inputs can be held prematurely to be input immediately after the game resumes. This essentially brings back behaviour from console releases which are lost on default because SoH isn't limited to N64 hardware.

settings.label: Simulated Input Lagframes
settings.desc: Buffers your inputs to be executed a specified amount of frames later.

settings.label: Reworked Targeting
settings.desc: Reworks targeting functionality - Press Z while locked always untargets (in Toggle mode) - Use the configured button combo to switch between targets

settings.label: Disable Crit Wiggle
settings.desc: Disable Random Camera Wiggle at Low Health.

settings.label: Better Owl
settings.desc: The default response to Kaepora Gaebora is always that you understood what he said.

settings.label: Easy Butterfly Fairies
settings.desc: Butterflies will transform into a fairy as soon as you approach them with a Deku Stick, skipping the need to stand still and let the butterfly land on your stick.

settings.label: Allow Dropping Throw-Only Objects
settings.desc: Allows normally throw-only objects (such as Cuccos, pots, grass, and small rocks) to be dropped by pressing A while standing still. Can be toggled while holding an object.

settings.label: Quit Fishing at Door
settings.desc: Fisherman asks if you want to quit at the door if you try to leave the Fishing Pond while still holding the Fishing Rod.

settings.label: Instant Putaway
settings.desc: Allow Link to put items away without having to wait around.

settings.label: Navi Timer Resets on Scene Change
settings.desc: Resets the Navi timer on scene change. If you have already talked to her, she will try and talk to you again, instead of needing a save warp or death.

settings.label: Link's Cow in Both Time Periods
settings.desc: Allows the Lon Lon Ranch Obstacle Course reward to be shared across time periods.

settings.label: Play Zelda's Lullaby to Open Sleeping Waterfall
settings.desc: Always: Link must always play Zelda's Lullaby to open the waterfall entrance to Zora's Domain. Once: Link only needs to play Zelda's Lullaby once to open the waterfall; after that, it stays open permanently. Never: Link never needs to play Zelda's Lullaby to open the waterfall. He only needs to have learned it and have an Ocarina.

settings.label: Skip Feeding Jabu-Jabu
settings.desc: Allow Link to enter Jabu-Jabu without feeding him a fish.

settings.label: Skip Warp Cutscenes
settings.desc: Warp songs skip the departure and arrival cutscenes, fading immediately to the destination.

settings.label: Skip One Point Cutscenes (Chests, Door Unlocks, etc.)
Exclude Glitch-Aiding Cutscenes
settings.desc: Don't skip cutscenes that are associated with useful glitches. Currently, it is only the Fire Temple Darunia CS, Forest Temple Poe Sisters CS, Dodongo Boss Door Switch CS, Water Temple Dragon Switch CS, the Box Skip One Point in Jabu, Early Hammer Switch CS in MQ Spirit, and Cow Switch Chest CS in MQ Jabu.

settings.label: Skip Bottle Pickup Messages
settings.desc: Skip Pickup Messages for Bottle Swipes.

settings.label: Skip Consumable Item Pickup Messages
settings.desc: Skip Pickup Messages for new Consumable Items.

settings.label: Skip Forced Dialog
settings.desc: Prevent forced conversations with Navi and/or other NPCs.

settings.label: Skip Text
settings.desc: Holding down B skips text.

settings.label: Slow Text Speedx
settings.desc: Changes the speed of sections of text that normally are paced slower than the text surrounding it.

settings.label: Faster Heavy Block Lift
settings.desc: Speeds up lifting Silver Rocks and Obelisks.

settings.label: Faster Shadow Ship
settings.desc: Speeds up ship in Shadow Temple.

settings.label: Fast Chests
settings.desc: Makes Link always kick the chest to open it, instead of doing the longer chest opening animation for major items.

settings.label: Improved Roll
settings.desc: Allows Link to chain a new roll by pressing A during a roll, maintaining maximum roll speed.

settings.label: Improved Roll Steering
settings.desc: Allows slight directional steering with the control stick while rolling. Steering is automatically disabled while Z is held, preserving Z-target roll glitch setups.

settings.label: Skip Water Take Breath Animation
settings.desc: Skips Link's taking breath animation after coming up from water. This setting does not interfere with getting items from underwater.

settings.label: Empty Bottles Faster
settings.desc: Speeds up emptying animation when dumping out the contents of a bottle.

settings.label: Exclude Glitch-Aiding Crawlspaces
settings.desc: Don't increase crawl speed when exiting glitch-useful crawlspaces. Currently it is only the BOTW crawlspace to a locked door.

settings.label: King Zora Speedx
settings.desc: Increase the speed of King Zora's move animation ("mweep")

settings.label: Faster Pause Menu
settings.desc: Speeds up animation of the pause menu, similar to Majora's Mask

settings.label: Skip Child Stealth##Enhancement
settings.desc: The crawlspace into Hyrule Castle goes straight to Zelda, skipping the guards.

settings.label: Skip Tower Escape
settings.desc: Skip the tower escape sequence between Ganondorf and Ganon.

settings.label: Skip Playing Scarecrow's Song
settings.desc: Pierre appears when an Ocarina is pulled out. Requires learning the Scarecrow's Song first. Without the randomizer option "Start with Scarecrow's Song" enabled for a seed, this still requires you to teach the scarecrow the song as both ages before summoning.

settings.label: Faster Rupee Accumulator
settings.desc: Causes your Wallet to fill and empty faster when you gain or lose money.

settings.label: No Skulltula Freeze
settings.desc: Stops the game from freezing the player when picking up Gold Skulltula Tokens. Does not apply in randomizer savefiles.

settings.label: Skip Save Confirmation
settings.desc: Skip the "Game Saved" confirmation screen.

settings.label: Link as Default File Name
settings.desc: Allows you to have "Link" as a premade file name.

settings.label: Spawn Bean Skulltula Faster
settings.desc: Makes Gold Skulltulas come out of bean patches faster after bugs dig into the center.

settings.label: Biggoron Forge Timedays
settings.desc: Allows you to change the number of days it takes for Biggoron to forge the Biggoron's Sword.

settings.label: Disable Bomb Billboarding
settings.desc: Disables bombs always rotating to face the camera. To be used in conjunction with mods that want to replace bombs with 3D objects.

settings.label: Disable Grotto Fixed Rotation
settings.desc: Disables Grottos rotating with the Camera. To be used in conjunction with mods that want to replace grottos with 3D objects.

settings.label: Disable Link's Sword Trail
settings.desc: Disables the sword trail effect when swinging Link's sword. Useful when using mods that replace Link's sword model.

settings.label: Disable 2D Pre-Rendered Scenes
settings.desc: Disables 2D pre-rendered backgrounds. Enable this when using a mod that implements 3D backdrops for these areas. Requires Scene Change to alter.

settings.label: Disable Fixed Camera
settings.desc: Disables the fixed camera in maps that use 2D pre-rendered backgrounds. Enable this when using a mod that implements 3D backdrops for these areas. Requires Scene Change to alter.

settings.label: Ingame Text Spacing
settings.desc: Space between text characters (useful for HD font textures).

settings.label: Disable LOD
settings.desc: Turns off the Level of Detail setting, making models use their Higher-Poly variants at any distance.

settings.label: Enemy Health Bars
settings.desc: Renders a health bar for Enemies when Z-Targeted.

settings.label: Enable 3D Dropped Items/Projectiles
settings.desc: Replaces most 2D items and projectiles on the overworld with their equivalent 3D models.

settings.label: Animated Link in Pause Menu
settings.desc: Turns the Static Image of Link in the Pause Menu's Equipment Subscreen into a model cycling through his idle animations.

settings.label: Show Age-Dependent Equipment
settings.desc: Makes all equipment visible, regardless of age.

settings.label: Scale Adult Equipment as Child
settings.desc: Scales all of the Adult Equipment, as well as moving some a bit, to fit on Child Link better. May not work properly with some mods.

settings.label: Show Gauntlets in First-Person
settings.desc: Renders Gauntlets when using the Bow and Hookshot like in OoT3D.

settings.label: Show Chains on Both Sides of Locked Doors
Color Temple of Time's Medallions
settings.desc: When Medallions are collected, the Medallion imprints around the Master Sword Pedestal in the Temple of Time will become colored-in.

settings.label: Minimal UI
settings.desc: Hides most of the UI when not needed. NOTE: Doesn't activate until scene transition.

settings.label: Disable Hot/Underwater Warning Text
settings.desc: Disables warning text when you don't have the Goron/Zora Tunic on in Hot/Underwater conditions.

settings.label: Remember Minimap State Between Areas
settings.desc: Preserve the minimap visibility state when going between areas rather than default it to "on" when going through loading zones.

settings.label: Visual Stone of Agony
settings.desc: Displays an icon and plays a sound when Stone of Agony should be activated, for those without rumble.

settings.label: Disable HUD Heart Animations
settings.desc: Disables the Beating Animation of the Hearts on the HUD.

settings.label: Glitch Line-up Tick
settings.desc: Displays a tick in the top center of the screen to help with glitch line-ups in SoH, since traditional UI based line-ups do not work outside of 4:3

settings.label: Disable Black Bar Letterboxes
settings.desc: Disables Black Bar Letterboxes during cutscenes and Z-Targeting. NOTE: There may be minor visual glitches that were covered up by the black bars. Please disable this setting before reporting a bug.

settings.label: Dynamic Wallet Icon
settings.desc: Changes the Rupee in the Wallet icon to match the wallet size you currently have.

settings.label: Always Show Dungeon Entrances
settings.desc: Always shows dungeon entrance icons on the Minimap.

settings.label: Better Ammo Rendering in Pause Menu
settings.desc: Ammo counts in the pause menu will work correctly regardless of the position of items in the Inventory.

settings.label: More Info
settings.desc: Shows what items you have collected in the File Select screen, like in N64 Randomizer.

settings.label: Enable Passage of Time
settings.desc: The skybox in the background of the File Select screen will go through the day and night cycle over time.

settings.label: Hide Original
settings.desc: Hides the original game when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

settings.label: Hide Master Quest
settings.desc: Hides the Master Quest option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

settings.label: Hide Randomizer
settings.desc: Hides the Randomizer option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

settings.label: Hide Boss Rush
settings.desc: Hides the Boss Rush option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

settings.label: Hide Speedrun
settings.desc: Hides the Speedrun option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

settings.label: Hide Speedrun Master Quest
settings.desc: Hides the Speedrun Master Quest option when selecting a quest type on the File Select screen.

settings.label: N64 Mode
settings.desc: Sets the aspect ratio to 4:3 and lowers resolution to 240p, the N64's native resolution.

settings.label: Remove Spin Attack Darkness
settings.desc: Remove the Darkness that appears when charging a Spin Attack.

settings.label: Disable Link Spinning With Goron Pot
settings.desc: Link will not spin when the Goron Pot starts to spin.

settings.label: Increase Actor Draw Distancex
settings.desc: Increases the range in which Actors/Objects are drawn.

settings.label: Disable Kokiri Fade
settings.desc: The Kokiri are mystical beings that fade into view when approached. Enabling this will remove their draw distance.

settings.label: Widescreen Actor Culling
settings.desc: Adjusts the Horizontal Culling Plane to account for Widescreen Resolutions.

settings.label: Cull Glitch Useful Actors
settings.desc: Exclude Actors that are useful for Glitches from the extended culling ranges. Some actors may still draw in the extended ranges, but will not "update" so that certain glitches that leverage the original culling requirements will still work.  The following actors are excluded:  - White Clothed Gerudos  - King Zora  - Gossip Stones  - Boulders  - Blue Warps  - Darunia  - Gold Skulltulas

settings.label: Equip Items on Dpad
settings.desc: Equip items and equipment on the D-pad. If used with "D-pad on Pause Screen", you must hold C-Up to equip instead of navigate.

settings.label: Allow unequipping Items
settings.desc: Allows unequipping items from C-Buttons/D-pad by hovering over an equipped item and pressing the button it's equipped to.

settings.label: Assignable Shields, Tunics and Boots
settings.desc: Allows equipping Shields, Tunics and Boots to C-Buttons/D-pad.

settings.label: Equipment Toggle
settings.desc: Allows equipment to be removed by toggling it on/off in the equipment subscreen.

settings.label: Allow Strength Equipment to be Toggled
settings.desc: Allows Strength to be toggled on and off by pressing A on the Strength Upgrade in the Equipment Subscreen of the Pause Menu. This allows performing some glitches that require the player to not have Strength.

settings.label: Unsheathe Sword Without Slashing
settings.desc: Allows Link to unsheathe the sword without slashing automatically.

settings.label: Sword Toggle Options
settings.desc: Introduces Options for unequipping Link's sword  None: Only Biggoron's Sword/Giant's Knife can be toggled. Doing so will equip the Master Sword.  Child Toggle: This will allow for completely unequipping any sword as Child link.  Both Ages: Any sword can be unequipped as either age. This may lead to swordless glitches as adult.

settings.label: Ask to Equip New Items
settings.desc: Adds a prompt to equip newly-obtained Swords, Shields, and Tunics.

settings.label: Prevent Dropped Ocarina Inputs
settings.desc: Prevent dropping inputs when playing the Ocarina too quickly.

settings.label: Fast Ocarina Playback
settings.desc: Skip the part where the Ocarina Playback is called when you play a song.

settings.label: Time Travel with Song of Time
settings.desc: Allows Link to freely change age by playing the Song of Time. Time Blocks can still be used properly.  Requirements:  - Obtained the Song of Time  - Obtained the Ocarina of Time (depends on selection)  - Obtained the Master Sword (depends on selection)  - Not within range of a Time Block  - Not within range of Ocarina Playing spots

settings.label: Persistent Masks
settings.desc: Stops masks from automatically unequipping in certain situations: - When entering a new scene - When not in any C-Button or the D-pad - When saving and quitting - When dying - When traveling through time (if "Masks Equippable as Adult" is activated)

settings.label: Invisible Bunny Hood
settings.desc: Turns Bunny Hood Invisible while still maintaining its effects.

settings.label: Mask Select in Inventory
settings.desc: After completing the mask trading sub-quest, press A and any direction on the mask slot to change masks.

settings.label: Remote Bombchu
settings.desc: Allows you to control a Bombchu after dropping it. Control Stick: Steer B: Detonate A: Quit Control

settings.label: Deku Nuts Explode Bombs
settings.desc: Make Deku Nuts explode Bombs, similar to how they interact with Bombchus. This does not affect Bomb Flowers.

settings.label: Remove Explosive Limit
settings.desc: Removes the cap of 3 active explosives being deployed at once.

settings.label: Static Explosion Radius
settings.desc: Explosions are now a static size, like in Majora's Mask and OoT3D. Makes Bombchu hovering much easier.

settings.label: Prevent Bombchus Forcing First-Person
settings.desc: Prevent Bombchus from forcing the camera into first-person mode when released.

settings.label: Better Bombchu Shopping
settings.desc: Bombchus do not sell out when bought, and a 10 pack of Bombchus costs 99 rupees instead of 100.

settings.label: Equip Multiple Arrows at Once
settings.desc: Allow the Bow and Magic Arrows to be equipped at the same time on different slots. NOTE: This will disable the behavior of the 'Equip Dupe' glitch.

settings.label: Blue Fire Arrows##Enhancement
settings.desc: Allows Ice Arrows to melt Red Ice. May require a room reload if toggled during gameplay.

settings.label: Sunlight Arrows##Enhancement
settings.desc: Allows Light Arrows to activate Sun Switches. May require a room reload if toggled during gameplay.

settings.label: Bow as Child/Slingshot as Adult
settings.desc: Allows Child Link to use a Bow with Arrows. Allows Adult Link to use a Slingshot with Seeds.  Requires glitches or the 'Timeless Equipment' cheat to equip.

settings.label: Aiming Reticle for the Bow/Slingshot
settings.desc: Aiming with a Bow or Slingshot will display a reticle as with the Hookshot when the projectile is ready to fire.

settings.label: Arrow Cycle
settings.desc: Allows cycling between different arrow types (Normal, Fire, Ice, Light) while aiming the bow. Press the R button to cycle to the next available arrow type. Only works when aiming and only cycles to arrow types you own with sufficient magic.

settings.label: Targetable Hookshot Reticle
settings.desc: Makes the Hookshot Reticle use a different color when aiming at hookshotable collision.

settings.label: Instant Boomerang Recall
settings.desc: Instantly return the Boomerang to Link by pressing its item button while it's in the air.

settings.label: Aim Boomerang in First-Person Mode
settings.desc: Change aiming for the Boomerang from Third-Person to First-Person to see past Link's head.

settings.label: Aiming Reticle for Boomerang
settings.desc: Aiming with the Boomerang will display a reticle as with the Hookshot.

settings.label: Better Farore's Wind
settings.desc: Helps FW persist between ages, gives Child and Adult separate FW points, and can be used in more places.

settings.label: Faster Farore's Wind
settings.desc: Greatly decreases cast time of Farore's Wind magic spell.

settings.label: Rebottle Blue Fire
settings.desc: Blue Fire dropped from a bottle can be bottled.

settings.label: Fix the Gravedigging Tour Glitch
settings.desc: Fixes a bug where the Gravedigging Tour Heart Piece disappears if the area reloads.

settings.label: Fix Dampé Going Backwards
settings.desc: Fixes Dampé going backwards in certain circumstances when the player is going backwards.

settings.label: Fix Kokiri Forest Quest State
settings.desc: Fixes Kokiri animation state to match their text state when getting Zelda's Letter before Kokiri Emerald.

settings.label: Fix Raised Floor Switches
settings.desc: Fixes the two raised floor switches, the one in the Forest Temple basement and the one at the top of the Fire Temple. This will lower them, making activating them easier.

settings.label: Fix Zora Hint Dialogue
settings.desc: Fixes one Zora's dialogue giving a hint about bringing Ruto's Letter to King Zora to properly occur before moving King Zora rather than after.

settings.label: Fix Falling from Vine Edges
settings.desc: Prevents immediately falling off climbable surfaces if climbing on the edges.

settings.label: Fix Bush Item Drops
settings.desc: Fixes the bushes to drop items correctly rather than spawning undefined items.

settings.label: Fix Flex Drops
settings.desc: The flex drop gives whichever ammo you are lowest on, but doesn't check that you own the item to hold it, so the drop is lost. This makes it skip ammo you can't carry.

settings.label: Fix Enemies not Spawning Near Water
settings.desc: Causes respawning enemies, like Stalchildren, to appear on land near bodies of water. Fixes an incorrect calculation that acted like water underneath ground was above it.

settings.label: Fix Poacher's Saw Softlock
settings.desc: Prevents the Poacher's Saw softlock from mashing through the text, or with Skip Text enabled.

settings.label: Fix Anubis Fireballs
settings.desc: Make Anubis Fireballs do Fire damage when reflected back at them with the Mirror Shield.

settings.label: Fix Goron City Doors After Fire Temple
settings.desc: Forces Goron City doors open if you somehow complete Fire Temple without talking to Goron Link and receiving the Goron Tunic.

settings.label: Fix MQ Water 1F Lock
settings.desc: The second small key lock in MQ Water Temple is removed before the player can reach it by a shared flag with some Stalfos on the way to Dark Link. Enabling this will cause that lock to use a different flag, working as intended.

settings.label: Fix Deku Nut Upgrade
settings.desc: Prevents the Forest Stage Deku Nut upgrade from becoming unobtainable after receiving the Poacher's Saw.

settings.label: Fix Megaton Hammer Crouch Stab
settings.desc: Make the Megaton Hammer's crouch stab able to destroy rocks without first swinging it normally.

settings.label: Remove Power Crouch Stab
settings.desc: Make crouch stabbing always do the same damage as a regular slash.

settings.label: Fix Broken Giant's Knife Bug
settings.desc: Fixes the Broken Giant's Knife flag not being reset when Medigoron fixes it.

settings.label: Fix Camera Drift
settings.desc: Fixes camera slightly drifting to the left when standing still due to a math error. May impact certain glitches.

settings.label: Fix Camera Swing
settings.desc: Fixes camera getting stuck on collision when standing still. Also fixes slight shift back in camera when Link stops moving. May impact certain glitches.

settings.label: Fix Hanging Ledge Swing Rate
settings.desc: Fixes camera swing rate when the player falls off a ledge and the camera swings around. May impact certain glitches.

settings.label: Fix L&R Pause Menu
settings.desc: Makes the L and R buttons in the pause menu the same color.

settings.label: Fix Dungeon Entrances
settings.desc: Removes the Dungeon Entrance icon on the top-left corner of the screen when no dungeon is present on the current map.

settings.label: Fix Two-Handed Idle Animations
settings.desc: Re-Enables the two-handed idle animation, a seemingly finished animation that was disabled on accident in the original game.

settings.label: Fix Navi Text HUD Position
settings.desc: Correctly centers the Navi text prompt on the HUD's C-Up button.

settings.label: Fix Gerudo Warrior's Clothing Colors
settings.desc: Prevent the Gerudo Warrior's clothes changing color when changing Link's tunic or using bombs in front of her.

settings.label: Fix Out of Bounds Textures
settings.desc: Fixes authentic out of bounds texture reads, instead loading textures with the correct size.

settings.label: Fix Link's Eyes Open while Sleeping
settings.desc: Fixes Link's eyes being open in the opening cutscene when he is supposed to be sleeping.

settings.label: Fix Hand Holding Hammer
settings.desc: Fixes Adult Link having a backwards left hand when holding the Megaton Hammer.

settings.label: Fix Vanishing Paths
settings.desc: Disabled: Paths vanish more the higher the resolution (Z-Fighting is based on resolution). Consistent: Certain paths vanish the same way in all resolutions. No Vanish: Paths do not vanish, Link seems to sink in to some paths. This might affect other decal effects.

settings.label: Fix Missing Jingle after 5 Silver Rupees
settings.desc: Adds 5 higher pitches for the Silver Rupee Jingle for the rooms with more than 5 Silver Rupees. Only relevant for playthroughs involving Master Quest Dungeons.

settings.label: Fix Darunia Dancing too Fast
settings.desc: Fixes Darunia's dancing speed so he dances to the beat of Saria's Song, like in the Original Game.

settings.label: Fix Credits Timing (PAL)
settings.desc: Extend certain credits scenes so the music lines up properly with the visuals. (PAL only)

settings.label: Red Ganon Blood
settings.desc: Restore the original red blood from NTSC 1.0/1.1. Disable for Green blood.

settings.label: Restore Old Gold Skulltula Cutscene
settings.desc: Restore pre-release behavior where defeating a Gold Skulltula will play a cutscene showing it die.

settings.label: Pulsate Boss Icon
settings.desc: Restores an unfinished feature to pulsate the boss room icon when you are in the boss room.

settings.label: Saria's Friends Forever Gesture
settings.desc: Restores an unused animation of Saria when she says, "Saria and Link will be friends forever."

settings.label: Fish while Hovering
settings.desc: Restore a bug from NTSC 1.0 that allows casting the Fishing Rod while using the Hover Boots.

settings.label: N64 Weird Frames
settings.desc: Restores N64 Weird Frames allowing weirdshots and weirdslides to behave the same as N64.

settings.label: Bombchus Out of Bounds
settings.desc: Allows Bombchus to explode out of bounds. Similar to GameCube and Wii VC.

settings.label: Quick Putaway
settings.desc: Restore a bug from NTSC 1.0 that allows putting away an item without an animation and performing Putaway Ocarina Items.

settings.label: Quick Bongo Kill
settings.desc: Restore a bug from NTSC 1.0 that allows bypassing Bongo Bongo's intro cutscene to quickly kill him.

settings.label: Early Eyeball Frog
settings.desc: Restores a bug from NTSC 1.0/1.1 that allows you to obtain the eyeball frog from King Zora instead of the Zora Tunic by Holding Shield.

settings.label: Child Hookshot Softlock
settings.desc: Using the Hookshot as child softlocks.

settings.label: Get Item Manipulation
settings.desc: Restores Get Item Manipulation. NTSC and PAL have separate tables.

settings.label: Fix L&Z Page Switch in Pause Menu
settings.desc: Makes L and R switch pages like on the GameCube. Z opens the Debug Menu instead.

settings.label: Wide Door Ranges
settings.desc: Restores the wider range of certain shutter doors from NTSC 1.0. Notably affects Jabu-Jabu and boss doors.

settings.label: Grave Hole Jumps
settings.desc: Restores NTSC 1.0 behavior where Link jumps over grave holes and grabs the ledges.

settings.label: Permanent Heart Loss
settings.desc: When you lose 4 quarters of a heart you will permanently lose that Heart Container.  Disabling this after the fact will restore your Heart Containers.

settings.label: Damage Multiplier
settings.desc: Modifies all sources of damage not affected by other sliders: 2x: Can survive all common attacks from the start of the game. 4x: Dies in 1 hit to any substantial attack from the start of the game. 8x: Can only survive trivial damage from the start of the game. 16x: Can survive all common attacks with max health without double defense. 32x: Can survive all common attacks with max health and double

settings.label: Fall Damage Multiplier
settings.desc: Modifies all fall damage: 2x: Can survive all fall damage from the start of the game. 4x: Can only survive short fall damage from the start of the game. 8x: Cannot survive any fall damage from the start of the game. 16x: Can survive all fall damage with max health without double defense. 32x: Can survive all fall damage with max health and double defense. 64x: Can survive short fall damage with do

settings.label: Void Damage Multiplier
settings.desc: Modifies damage taken after falling into a void: 2x: Can survive void damage from the start of the game. 4x: Cannot survive void damage from the start of the game. 8x: Can survive void damage twice with max health without double defense. 16x: Can survive void damage with max health without double defense. 32x: Can survive void damage with max health and double defense. 64x: Cannot survive void dam

settings.label: Bonk Damage Multiplier
settings.desc: Modifies Damage taken after Bonking.

settings.label: Spawn with Full Health
settings.desc: Respawn with Full Health instead of 3 hearts.

settings.label: No Heart Drops
settings.desc: Disables Heart Drops, but not Heart Placements, like from a Deku Scrub running off. This simulates Hero Mode from other games in the series.

settings.label: No Random Drops
settings.desc: Disables Random Drops, except from the Goron Pot, Dampe, and Bosses.

settings.label: Enable Bombchu Drops
settings.desc: Bombchus will sometimes drop in place of Bombs.

settings.label: Trees Drop Sticks
settings.desc: Bonking into Trees will have a chance to drop up to 3 Sticks. Must have obtained sticks previously.

settings.label: Dampe Drop Rate
settings.desc: Adjusts rate Dampe drops flames during race.

settings.label: Switch Timer Multiplier
settings.desc: -5 will be half as much time, +5 will be 6x as much time. Affects timed switches, torches, GTG statue eyes, & doors in race with Dampe.

settings.label: Minimum Heat/Water Timerseconds
settings.desc: Limits how low heat timer or underwater timer can start.

settings.label: Always Win Goron Pot
settings.desc: Always get the Heart Piece/Purple Rupee from the Spinning Goron Pot.

settings.label: Always Win Dampe Digging Game
settings.desc: Always win the Heart Piece/Purple Rupee on the first dig in Dampe's Grave Digging game. In a Randomizer file, this defaults to on if this enhancement has never been changed.

settings.label: All Dogs are Richard
settings.desc: All dogs can be traded in and will count as Richard.

settings.label: Cuccos Stay Put Multiplierx
settings.desc: Cuccos will stay in place longer after putting them down, by a multiple of the value of the slider.

settings.label: Cuccos Needed By Anju
settings.desc: The amount of cuccos needed to receive the bottle from Anju the Cucco Lady.

settings.label: Hyper Bosses
settings.desc: All Major Bosses move and act twice as fast.

settings.label: Hyper Enemies
settings.desc: All Regular Enemies and Mini-Bosses move and act twice as fast.

settings.label: Leever Spawn Rateseconds
settings.desc: The time between groups of Leevers spawning.

settings.label: Customize Behavior##Shooting
settings.desc: Turn on/off changes to the shooting gallery behavior.

settings.label: Instant Win
settings.desc: Skips the Shooting Gallery minigame.

settings.label: No Rupee Randomization
settings.desc: Forces the rupee order to not be randomized as adult, making it the same as child.

settings.label: Child Starting Ammunitionseeds
settings.desc: The ammunition at the start of the Shooting Gallery minigame as Child.

settings.label: Adult Starting Ammunitionarrows
settings.desc: The ammunition at the start of the Shooting Gallery minigame as Adult.

settings.label: Customize Behavior##Bowling
settings.desc: Turn on/off changes to the Bombchu Bowling behavior.

settings.label: Remove Small Cucco
settings.desc: Prevents the small Cucco from appearing in the Bombchu Bowling minigame.

settings.label: Remove Big Cucco
settings.desc: Prevents the big Cucco from appearing in the Bombchu Bowling minigame.

settings.label: Bombchu Countbombchus
settings.desc: The number of Bombchus available at the start of the Bombchu Bowling minigame.

settings.label: First Prize
settings.desc: The prize the cycle starts on.

settings.label: Customize Behavior##HBA
settings.desc: Turn on/off changes to the Horseback Archery minigame behavior.

settings.label: Instant Win##HBA
settings.desc: Skips the Horseback Archery minigame, automatically awarding the prize.

settings.label: Always Score 100##HBA
settings.desc: Every arrow that hits a target scores 100 points (inner ring) regardless of where it lands.

settings.label: Arrow Count
settings.desc: The number of arrows available at the start of the Horseback Archery minigame.

settings.label: Customize Behavior##Frogs
settings.desc: Turn on/off changes to the Frogs' Ocarina Game behavior.

settings.label: Instant Win##Frogs
settings.desc: Skips the Frogs' Ocarina Game.

settings.label: Unlimited Playback Time##Frogs
settings.desc: Removes the timer to play back the song.

settings.label: Modify Note Timerx
settings.desc: Adjusts the time allowed for playback before failing.

settings.label: Customize Behavior##LostWoods
settings.desc: Turn on/off changes to the Lost Woods Ocarina Game behavior.

settings.label: Instant Win##LostWoods
settings.desc: Skips the Lost Woods Ocarina Memory Game.

settings.label: Note Play Speedx
settings.desc: Adjust the speed that the Skull Kids play the notes.

settings.label: Unlimited Playback Time##LostWoods
settings.desc: Removes the timer to play back the song.

settings.label: Number of Starting Notesnotes
settings.desc: Adjust the number of notes the Skull Kids play to start the first round.

settings.label: Solve Amy's Puzzle
settings.desc: Amy's block-pushing puzzle is instantly solved.

settings.label: Number of Races
settings.desc: Number of races Link must win against Ingo to earn Epona. Only works if Link is riding Epona, not the other rideable horse.

settings.label: Customize Behavior##Fishing
settings.desc: Turn on/off changes to the Fishing behavior.

settings.label: Instant Fishing
settings.desc: All fish will be caught instantly.

settings.label: Guarantee Bite
settings.desc: When a line is stable, guarantee a bite. Otherwise use Default logic.

settings.label: Fish never Escape
settings.desc: Once a hook has been set, Fish will never let go while being reeled in.

settings.label: Loaches always Appear
settings.desc: Loaches will always appear in the fishing pond instead of every four visits.

settings.label: Skip Keep Confirmation
settings.desc: The Pond Owner will not ask to confirm if you want to keep a smaller Fish.

settings.label: All Fish are Hyrule Loaches
settings.desc: Every fish in the Fishing Pond will always be a Hyrule Loach.  NOTE: This requires reloading the area.

settings.label: Child Minimum Weightlbs.
settings.desc: The minimum weight for the unique Fishing Reward as a child.

settings.label: Adult Minimum Weightlbs.
settings.desc: The minimum weight for the unique fishing reward as an adult.

settings.label: Allow fishing with blank B
settings.desc: Allow fishing even when not having any item equipped on the B button, fixing a vanilla bug. Always enabled in randomizer.

settings.label: Dampe's Race
settings.desc: Dampe awards both prizes on the first race, not just the Hookshot.

settings.label: Horseback Archery
settings.desc: Link can win both Horseback Archery prizes in one attempt

settings.label: Bounce off Walls
settings.desc: Allows Link to bounce off walls when linear velocity is high enough. This is relevant when frequently being knocked back by traps, CC, or in Anchor.

settings.label: Mirrored World
settings.desc: Mirrors the world horizontally:   - Always: Always mirror the world.  - Random: Randomly decide to mirror the world on each scene change.  - Random (Seeded): Scenes are mirrored based on the current randomizer seed/file.  - Dungeons: Mirror the world in Dungeons.  - Dungeons (Vanilla): Mirror the world in Vanilla Dungeons.  - Dungeons (MQ): Mirror the world in MQ Dungeons.  - Dungeons Random: Rand

settings.label: Ivan the Fairy (Coop Mode)
settings.desc: Enables Ivan the Fairy. Player 2 can control Ivan and press the C-Buttons to use items and mess with Player 1!

settings.label: Dogs Follow You Everywhere
settings.desc: Allows dogs to follow you anywhere you go, even if you leave the Market.

settings.label: Rupee Dash Mode
settings.desc: Rupees reduce over time; Link suffers damage when the count hits 0.

settings.label: Rupee Dash Wallet Scaling
settings.desc: The larger Link's wallet, the faster Rupees reduce.

settings.label: Rupee Dash Intervalseconds
settings.desc: Interval between Rupee reduction in Rupee Dash Mode.

settings.label: Shadow Tag Mode
settings.desc: A Wallmaster follows Link everywhere, don't get caught!

settings.label: Hurt Container Mode
settings.desc: Changes Heart Piece and Heart Container functionality.   - Each Heart Container or full Heart Piece reduces Link's Hearts by 1.  - Can be enabled retroactively after a File has already started.

settings.label: Additional Traps
settings.desc: Enables additional Trap variants.

settings.label: Teleport Traps
settings.desc: Where a Teleport Trap can send you. Off keeps them out of the trap pool.  Simple: Link's House and the six warp song pads. Advanced: The same pool the randomizer uses when it shuffles spawns and warp songs.

settings.label: Timeless Equipment
settings.desc: Allows any item to be equipped, regardless of age. Also allows child to use adult strength upgrades.

settings.label: Unrestricted Items
settings.desc: Allows you to use any item at any location

settings.label: Super Tunic
settings.desc: Makes every tunic have the effects of every other tunic.

settings.label: Fireproof Deku Shield
settings.desc: Prevents the Deku Shield from burning on contact with fire.

settings.label: Shield with Two-Handed Weapons
settings.desc: This allows you to put up your shield with any two-handed weapon in hand except for Deku Sticks.

settings.label: Hookshot Everything
settings.desc: Makes every surface in the game hookshotable.

settings.label: No Clip
settings.desc: Allows you to walk through walls.

settings.label: Climb Everything
settings.desc: Makes every surface in the game climbable.

settings.label: Moon Jump on L
settings.desc: Holding L makes you float into the air.

settings.label: No ReDead/Gibdo Freeze
settings.desc: Prevents ReDeads and Gibdos from being able to freeze you with their scream.

settings.label: Keese/Guay don't Target You
settings.desc: Keese and Guay no longer target you and simply ignore you as if you were wearing the Skull Mask.

settings.label: Disable Haunted Wasteland Sandstorm
settings.desc: Disables sandstorm effect in Haunted Wasteland.

settings.label: Targetable Gold Skulltula
settings.desc: Allows Z-Targeting Gold Skulltulas.

settings.label: Easy Frame Advancing with Pause
settings.desc: Continue holding START button when unpausing to only advance a single frame and then re-pause.

settings.label: Easy ISG
settings.desc: Passive Infinite Sword Glitch It makes your sword's swing effect and hitbox stay active indefinitely.

settings.label: Easy QPA
settings.desc: Gives you the glitched damage value of the quick put away glitch.

settings.label: Drops Don't Despawn
settings.desc: Drops from enemies, grass, etc. don't disappear after a set amount of time.

settings.label: Fish don't Despawn
settings.desc: Prevents fish from automatically despawning after a while when dropped.

settings.label: Bugs don't Despawn
settings.desc: Prevents bugs from automatically despawning after a while when dropped.

settings.label: Freeze Time
settings.desc: Freezes the time of day.

settings.label: Time Sync
settings.desc: Syncs the in-game time with the real world time.

settings.label: I promise I have read the warning
I understand, enable save states
settings.desc: F5 to save, F6 to change slots, F7 to load

settings.label: Enable Beta Quest
settings.desc: Turns on OoT Beta Quest. *WARNING*: This will reset your game!

settings.label: Beta Quest World
settings.desc: Set the Beta Quest world to explore. *WARNING*: Changing this will reset your game! Ctrl+Click to type in a value.
